about_the_game:
Trapped on an island overrun by infected creatures, survivors must work together to stay alive in a hostile environment:

  • Scavenge essential supplies such as food, medicine, armor, gas masks, and more.

  • Fight off increasingly powerful infected enemies—their numbers and strength grow as the toxic fog spreads.

  • Some traps and defensive items can be found on the map, and players can use them to block the infected's attacks.

  • The map periodically reveals new “flipped” areas, encouraging constant exploration until the entire island is uncovered.

  • In the final phase of survival, players’ weapons will be automatically replaced with high-damage versions to face tougher threats.

  • Collect shards throughout the game to upgrade your weapons and enhance your combat effectiveness.

Development Status

This game is currently in Early Access. Content is still under development, and more features and updates will be added over time.

name: Infected Escaped

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 @ 3.7GHz or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon HD 7850 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9600K @ 3.7GHz or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 Super / AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

short_description: A co-op PvE survival game where you team up with other survivors to scavenge resources, fight infected enemies, uncover the map, and reach the final extraction point.
supported_languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Japanese, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Spanish - Latin America, Korean
